test_title: PYST 70: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 23 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

I have booked an apartment in the new residential colony.

options.text: An apartment have been booked by me in the new residential colony.
An apartment had been booked by me in the new residential colony.
An apartment is been booked by me in the new residential colony.
An apartment has been booked by me in the new residential colony.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "I have booked an apartment in the new residential colony."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "an apartment" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "have booked" to "has been booked" (present perfect passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "me."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"An apartment has been booked by me in the new residential colony."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"An apartment have been booked by me in the new residential colony." – Incorrect subject-verb agreement (have been instead of has been).
 
• **Option 2: **"An apartment had been booked by me in the new residential colony." – Incorrect tense (past perfect passive).
 
• **Option 3: **"An apartment is been booked by me in the new residential colony." – Incorrect verb form (is been instead of has been).

40:T
